snapshots.note: v1 draft: flat 77-option choice with descriptions encoding phase-1 policy answers
v2: beneficiary_not_allowed covers 'transfer not allowed'; small ~1-unit unrecognised charges -> extra_charge_on_statement. 10/10 on check (was 8/10)
v4: v2 + card top-up money gone -> topping_up_by_card, flat/mortgage payment error -> failed_transfer, bare 'why was I charged' -> transfer_fee_charged. 15/17 bought labels

e6: 3-member wording ensemble of v6 rules (outgoing transfer not arrived -> transfer_not_received_by_recipient, found card -> card_linking, shop decline vs card_not_working, card delivery how/when -> estimate, cash fee -> cash_withdrawal_charge). 25/26 bought labels (mostly hard picks), check 10/10

e7: e6 + Amex/card brand top-up -> supported_cards_and_currencies, 'doesn't show up/appear/update balance' transfer -> balance_not_updated, incoming transfer wait -> transfer_timing. 30/34 bought labels (hard picks)

e9 FINAL: e7 + cash showing in app -> cash_withdrawal_not_recognised, repeated never-goes-through -> card_not_working, wanting a Visa -> visa_or_mastercard, identity-check how-to -> verify_my_identity, 'told transfer not possible' -> beneficiary_not_allowed. 35/39 bought labels (mostly hard picks); random check 10/10
